en.setting.StackAmount.name: Stack multiplier (1 = normal; no hard maximum)

en.setting.EnergyConsumptionRate.name: Energy-consumption multiplier (0 = no use; 1 = normal)
en.setting.StaminaRecoveryRate.name: Stamina-recovery multiplier (1 = normal; no hard maximum)

en.setting.FoodConsumtionRate.name: Food-consumption multiplier (0 = no use; 1 = normal)
en.setting.WaterConsumtionRate.name: Water-consumption multiplier (0 = no use; 1 = normal)

en.setting.EnemyDisplayCount.name: Enemy marker threshold (5 = game default; restart required)
